description: This source file defines the EclipseWriter class responsible for generating Eclipse CDT project settings XML files based on build targets, include directories, and macro definitions. It includes methods for collecting include paths and defines from build targets, escaping XML content, and writing the configuration XML.

classes.name: EclipseWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for generating Eclipse CDT project configuration files based on build target information, include directories, and macro definitions.

methods.name: EscapeForXML
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for safe inclusion in XML content.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Static method to create an EclipseWriter instance, run it, and write the configuration XML to a file.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of collecting include directories, defines, and writing the CDT settings XML.

methods.name: GetAllIncludeDirs
methods.description: Collects all include directories from build targets that use the default toolchain.

methods.name: GetAllDefines
methods.description: Collects all macro definitions from build targets that use the default toolchain.

methods.name: UsesDefaultToolchain
methods.description: Checks if a target uses the default toolchain.

methods.name: WriteCDTSettings
methods.description: Writes the collected include directories and macro definitions into an Eclipse CDT project settings XML file.
